### Tools

| Tool | What it does | Read-only | Destructive | Posture |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `list_calendars` | List the calendars on the user's calendar list with their ids, names, time zones and the user's access role. The user's own calendar is also reachable as the id primary; a shared calendar's id looks like team@group.calendar.google.com. Pass nextPageToken back as pageToken for the next page. | yes | no | auto |
| `list_events` | List the events of one calendar between two times, for example calendarId=primary, timeMin=2026-10-21T00:00:00Z, timeMax=2026-10-28T00:00:00Z, singleEvents=true, orderBy=startTime. Times are RFC 3339 with an offset. q searches the summary, description, location and attendees. Pass nextPageToken back as pageToken for the next page. | yes | no | auto |
| `get_event` | Read one event by calendar id (or primary) and event id (from list\_events), with its attendees and their responses. | yes | no | auto |
| `query_free_busy` | Return the busy intervals of one or more calendars between timeMin and timeMax (RFC 3339), for example items=\[{"id": "primary"}, {"id": "bob@example.com"}\]. Use it to find a time that suits everyone; a calendar Google could not check comes back with errors (such as notFound) instead of busy times. | yes | no | auto |
| `create_event` | Create an event. start and end each take dateTime (RFC 3339, for example 2026-10-22T15:00:00-07:00) or, for an all-day event, date (2026-10-22). Attendees are \[{"email": "bob@example.com"}\]; set sendUpdates=all to email them an invitation, or leave it out to send none. | no | no | ask |
| `quick_add_event` | Create an event from one line of text that Google parses, for example "Lunch with Bob tomorrow 12:30-13:30" or "Dentist on Friday at 9am". Use create\_event to set attendees or a description. | no | no | ask |
| `update_event` | Change some fields of an event and keep the rest, for example a new start and end, or another summary. Set sendUpdates=all to tell the attendees. | no | no | ask |
| `delete_event` | Delete an event by calendar id and event id. Set sendUpdates=all to tell the attendees it is cancelled. | no | yes | deny |

### Tools

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
